1.w: For the one directing. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O YHWH our Lord, how majestic [is] Your name in all the earth, who have set Your splendor above the heavens!

2.w: From the mouth of infants and sucklings You have established strength, on account of Your adversaries, to still the enemy and avenger.

3.w: When I see Your heavens, the works of Your fingers, the moon and the stars that You have established—

4.w: what [is] man that You should remember him, and the son of man, that You would attend to him?

5.w: And You made him lacking a little from the angels, and with glory and honor You crowned him.

6.w: You made him to rule over the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:

7.w: All sheep and cattle, and also the beasts of the field,

8.w: the birds of the heavens and the fish of the sea, those passing [on] the paths of the seas.

9.w: O YHWH, our Lord, how majestic [is] Your name in all the earth!
